description: Dog the mail carrier brings seven unlabelled parcels to Letter Street. Robo, Duck and Dog match M, N, O, P, Q, R and S to the houses by their first sounds, turn an upside-down W into M and a lying Z into N, and watch an O grow a tail (Q) and a P grow a leg (R).

youtube.title: Letters M N O P Q R S! Alphabet Delivery for Preschool | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Special delivery on Letter Street! Dog the mail carrier has seven parcels, but the labels fell off. Robo and Duck match each capital letter to a house by its first sound: M for moon, N for nest, O for octopus, P for pig, Q for queen bee, R for rocket and S for sun. Kids learn the shape, the name and the sound of each letter, see that Q is an O with a tail and R is a P with a leg, and turn an upside-down W into M.

Try it at home with a grown-up: write M, N, O, P, Q, R and S on sticky notes and be the mail carrier. Stick each letter on something that starts with its sound (a mug, a napkin, a pillow, a rug, a sock). Only stick notes where a grown-up says it's okay, never on the stove, sockets or anything hot. Then draw an O and add a tail to make Q!

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Oh no! The labels fell off!
Which parcel goes to which house?
Each house has a picture. Let's listen to the first sound!
Quack! We know A to L. Let's go!
Hmm. Is it a W? Let's turn it over!
M has two tall lines... and two pointy hills.
Mittens keep fingers together. Thumbs get their own spot!
Is that a Z? It's lying down!
Let's stand it up. What will it be?
N has two tall lines... and one slide.
It rolls like a wheel. It's O!
O is one round line. No corners!
P has one tall line... and a bump at the top.
That's me! Pig starts with P!

scenes.title: Q is O with a tail

do.text: This house has a bee... with a crown!
Another O! What will this O turn into?
It grew a little tail. It's Q!
Q is an O... with a tail!
A queen bee is the mommy of her whole hive.
My word! Quack starts with Q!
Yes! Q likes a U friend, too.

scenes.title: R is P with a leg

do.text: It's stamping its foot. What will this P turn into?
A leg slid out. It's R!
R is a P... with a leg!
The last house has a sun.
S is one curvy line. Like a snake!
Trace a big S in the air with me!
Letter Street! Say them with me.
We did it! M to S!
M N O P Q R S
Which letter is an O with a tail?
Which letter is a P with a leg?
M! Two tall lines, points up!
Bye-bye, M, N, O, P, Q, R, S!
